notices.short_title: Proposed Rules - Amendment of Rules relating to Sidewalk Sheds
notices.plain: The Department of Buildings will hold a public hearing on April 27, 2026, on proposed rules amending its rules for sidewalk sheds.

notices.short_title: COMMITTEE ON CONTRACTS AGENDA
notices.plain: The Department of Education's Committee on Contracts will hold a public hearing on its agenda of contract awards, as listed in a notice published March 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: NIGHTINGALE MID BACK TASK CHAIRS

notices.short_title: ONE TIME PURCHASE OF COVERALLS

notices.short_title: Design Build Solar PV 1

notices.short_title: FY27 Supportive Housing Contracts

notices.short_title: IBM Websphere and SPSS Licenses
